1.why: Body text uses a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line height on every screen, although the simulation Logs panel is small, dense monospace text.

2.why: All instructions are short sentence-case lines with no italics, all-caps, or dense paragraphs; only the 'NORTHSTAR BANK' brand header is capitalised.

3.why: The single-column mobile-width layout is tidy at first, but in steps 10-17 up to eight stacked duplicate 'Unable to continue sign-in.' banners push the sign-in form far below the fold.

4.why: Instructions are one or two plain sentences each, though jargon such as 'provisioning value', 'provisioning representation', and the raw otpauth URI is not plain language.

5.why: Only the recovery-code field shows a format placeholder (ABCD-EFGH-JKLM); the verification-code and authenticator-code fields display no example of the expected six-digit input.

6.why: No screen forces the user to read a long prose block to proceed; the only dense text (otpauth URI, simulation logs) is optional reference material.

7.why: The 32-character manual secret and the recovery codes are rendered as selectable plain text rather than images, although no one-tap copy button is provided.

8.why: Despite the instruction to 'scan the provisioning value', no QR code is ever displayed at any step; only a wrapping text otpauth URI and the manual secret are offered.

9.why: The standard labelled login-name and password fields would likely work with password managers, but nothing observed indicates autocomplete or one-time-code autofill support on the OTP and recovery-code inputs.

10.why: Each screen has a single bold heading and a full-width high-contrast green primary button, so the current step and main action stand out even on the error-laden screens.

11.why: Every screen asks for one primary action via the green button, with alternatives demoted to plain links or a grey secondary button (e.g. 'Generate replacement recovery codes').

12.why: Successful transitions are explained ('MFA is enabled' plus storage instructions), but failed sign-ins only repeat 'Unable to continue sign-in.' and once a raw DOM exception, never stating what happens next.

13.why: Retries are allowed without lockout (eight sign-in attempts observed), but there is no reveal/hide toggle on the password field and no resend or re-request option for the verification code.

14.why: Error messages are non-blaming but uninformative: 'Unable to continue sign-in.' and the technical 'Failed to execute insertBefore on Node' banner never state the actual problem or how to fix it.

15.why: Reading has no time limit, but the authenticator code 'rotates every 30 seconds' and the verification code is described as 'short-lived', imposing tight rather than generous code-entry windows.
